what: The 8px dot at the end of line and pill buttons grows 1.5x when you hover the link or button holding it, and a 4px background-colored hole opens in the center to make a ring (.2s ease). The hole stands apart from the dot so its size stays unchanged. The ‹on-accent› type is a white dot on an accent-color button with an accent-color hole.

options.--fx-size: Dot diameter (via style), default 8px — the button at top of page turn is 12px
options.--fx-scale: Grow scale (via style), default 1.5 — menu drawer rows 1.3
options.--fx-hole: Hole diameter (via style, relative to the dot), default 50% (4px for an 8px dot)
options.--fx-hole-ink: Hole color (via style), default var(--kf-bg) — the background color the dots sit on
options.look: on-accent: On the accent-colored pill button — a white dot (--kf-on-accent) with an accent-colored hole

use: Your news title here

from.where: shared.css .sh-dot (news row, treatment item row, pill button, banner, bottom link strip, back to top)
